milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted oak_planks end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 oak_logs and 0 oak_planks, so any oak_planks in inventory confirms successful crafting. Oak planks can be crafted in the personal 2x2 grid (1 log → 4 planks).

Uses inventory_has because the crafted oak_door ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 oak_doors, so any oak_door in inventory confirms successful crafting. The recipe requires 6 oak_planks in a 3x3 grid (crafting table needed) and yields 3 doors, so min_count=1 is appropriately lenient.
